title: Pakka bill chahiye, dukaan ke naam ka
caption:
Customer ne pakka bill maanga aur aapke paas sirf kachchi parchi thi? Aap bill kaise banate hain? 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 din muft: link in bio.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a hardware shop owner who makes a numbered bill with his items and payment details and shares it as a PDF or WhatsApp message. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Imran: Imran is a man in his late thirties who runs a small hardware shop, with a trimmed beard, a grey checked shirt and rolled-up sleeves.
cast.Verma ji: Verma ji is a building contractor in his fifties with grey hair, glasses and a white shirt, carrying a file.

scenes.vo: इमरान की हार्डवेयर की दुकान पर वर्मा जी आए।
scenes.sub: Imran ki hardware ki dukaan par Verma ji aaye.
scenes.art: Imran behind the counter of a small hardware shop with paint tins, pipes and tools on shelves, Verma ji walking in with a file, morning light.

scenes.vo: उन्होंने सीमेंट और पाइप का बड़ा ऑर्डर दिया।
scenes.sub: Unhone cement aur pipe ka bada order diya.
scenes.art: Verma ji pointing at cement bags and a bundle of pipes, Imran noting it down happily.

scenes.vo: फिर बोले, मुझे दुकान के नाम का पक्का बिल चाहिए।
scenes.sub: Phir bole, mujhe dukaan ke naam ka pakka bill chahiye.
scenes.art: Verma ji holding out his file and tapping it, Imran looking up from the counter.

scenes.vo: इमरान के पास बस एक कच्ची पर्ची थी।
scenes.sub: Imran ke paas bas ek kachchi parchi thi.
scenes.art: Imran holding a small torn slip of paper with a worried face, a pen behind his ear.

scenes.vo: हाथ से लिखता, तो नंबर और हिसाब गड़बड़ हो जाता।
scenes.sub: Haath se likhta, toh number aur hisaab gadbad ho jaata.
scenes.art: Imran scratching his head over a messy handwritten pad with crossed-out lines, Verma ji waiting patiently.

scenes.vo: उसने फ़ोन निकाला और स्कोर माय बिज़ खोला।
scenes.sub: Usne phone nikaala aur ScoreMyBiz khola.
scenes.art: Imran taking his phone out of his shirt pocket with a small confident smile.

scenes.vo: सामान चुना, तो नंबर वाला बिल अपने आप बन गया।
scenes.sub: Saamaan chuna, toh number wala bill apne aap ban gaya.

scenes.vo: उसमें दुकान का नाम और यूपीआई की जानकारी भी थी।
scenes.sub: Usmein dukaan ka naam aur UPI ki jaankari bhi thi.

scenes.vo: बिल सीधे वर्मा जी के व्हाट्सऐप पर पहुँच गया।
scenes.sub: Bill seedhe Verma ji ke WhatsApp par pahunch gaya.
scenes.art: Verma ji looking at his own phone and nodding with approval, Imran watching with a smile.

scenes.vo: पैसे आए, तो इमरान ने बिल पर चुकता लगा दिया।
scenes.sub: Paise aaye, toh Imran ne bill par chukta laga diya.
scenes.art: Imran tapping his phone once with satisfaction while Verma ji puts his phone back in his pocket.

scenes.vo: वर्मा जी बोले, अब हर बार यहीं से लूँगा।
scenes.sub: Verma ji bole, ab har baar yahin se loonga.
scenes.art: Verma ji shaking hands with Imran across the counter, cement bags being loaded onto a cart behind.

scenes.vo: आपके ग्राहक पक्का बिल माँगते हैं, तो आप क्या करते हैं?
scenes.sub: Aapke grahak pakka bill maangte hain, toh aap kya karte hain?
scenes.art: Close-up of Imran smiling warmly at the viewer, hardware shelves softly blurred behind.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
